mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson's r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5pp does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson's r < -0.15).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over two months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decline > 5% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson's r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% MoM does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson's r < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS > 5% and rising CPIAUCSL does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson's r < -0.15).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200k for 2 months does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson's r < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth below 2% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 QoQ growth < 2% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson's r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 70% of instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS < 1% does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson's r < 0.15).
